name: Calmbreeze Inn
summary: In Shen'dar Village and Valaanar, Calmbreeze Inns offer travelers rest on Zephras Isle. Both provide shelter and local services.

sections.title: Rest on the Isle
sections.body:
Travelers can rest at the Calmbreeze Inns on Zephras Isle. Coriella Calmbreeze runs the inn in Shen'dar Village, where island tradesfolk gather. There, you can find mentors in herbalism, skinning, and enchanting.

Across the way, the Valaanar inn welcomes local wayfarers and shelters rare curios. Upstairs, an audio crystal holds a recording of the ancient rebellion in Eldre'Thalas.

faq.q: Where are the Calmbreeze Inns located?
faq.answer: Calmbreeze Inns are found in Shen'dar Village and Valaanar on Zephras Isle.

faq.q: Who runs the inn in Shen'dar Village?
faq.answer: Innkeeper Coriella Calmbreeze runs the Shen'dar Village inn and welcomes island residents and travelers.

faq.q: What trainers can be found at the inn?
faq.answer: At the Shen'dar Village inn, Halassa Fernbreeze teaches Herbalism, Mendalass Tattermend teaches Skinning, Nasalanna Windsinger teaches Enchanting, and Miriann Mistblade teaches Rogue training.

faq.q: What is the audio crystal found upstairs in Valaanar?
faq.answer: Upstairs in the Valaanar inn, an audio crystal holds Part 3 of 'The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas', recounting events from the ancient Highborne city.

angles.text: As an herbalist in Shen'dar Village, you can find Halassa Fernbreeze inside the Calmbreeze Inn and hone your gathering craft.
As a rogue in Shen'dar Village, you can seek instruction from Miriann Mistblade at the Calmbreeze Inn hearth.
